content:
nora: Customer SmartGrid (acct SG-440) flagged INV-2026-210: looks like they were charged reserved capacity in two regions for April (US-EAST + EU-WEST). They only have a single reserved commit. Asking for correction + SLA credit due to failover disruption.
chris: Oof. Do we have the invoice lines and any event logs? Need to see whether EU-WEST was incorrectly billed as reserved or if a dedicated migration created a duplicate commit line.
billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-210 lines:
```
Line 1: RSRV-US-EAST-2026, qty 1, period 2026-04-01 - 2026-04-30, amt $15,000
Line 2: RSRV-EU-WEST-2026, qty 1, period 2026-04-01 - 2026-04-30, amt $15,000
Line 3: OVG-TOK, 300,000 tokens, amt $1,500
Total $31,500
```
ev an: Ops: We had an automatic failover event on 2026-04-14 02:05 that spun up EU-WEST dedicated nodes as a temporary failover. That deployment should have been billed as burst/overage minutes, not a full reserved SKU. Logs show the EU-WEST pool was created with temp tag 'failover-ephemeral' and then incorrectly flagged as 'reserved' by the provisioning job.
chris: Ok that explains it. Customer saw ~3h of degraded traffic and some token spikes during the switch. They asked for 1) reversal of the EU-WEST reserved line, 2) reimbursement for the burst tokens above normal, and 3) an SLA credit for the partial outage.
cs-rep: Customer message: "We only signed 1 reserved commit for US-EAST. We were surprised to see an EU-WEST reserved charge. Also saw a spike during failover. Please correct and advise on SLA credits."
nora: Quick calc suggestion: refund reserved EU-WEST $15,000 in full since it was mis-tagged. Burst overage line $1,500 should be reviewed; propose to credit full $1,500 since spikes were migration-related. SLA: per contract 10% monthly credit on verified outage window; pro-rated monthly fee (US-EAST $15k) => 10% = $1,500. Total proposed credit = $15,000 + $1,500 + $1,500 = $18,000.
chris: That matches my back-of-envelope. Need supporting docs: ops incident report, provisioning error log, metering snippet showing burst spike. Also finance approval for > $5k credits.
billing-bot: Metering snapshot (Apr 12-16) for SG-440:
```
2026-04-12,committed_units,burst_units
2026-04-12,900000,20000
2026-04-14,900000,280000
2026-04-15,900000,40000
TOTAL_WINDOW,900000,340000
```
evan: I attached incident doc INC-2026-087 (provisioning race condition) and logs showing reserved flagging bug (prov-job#4522). Ops accepts responsibility for mis-tagging.
finance_lead: Please prepare credit memo and reissued invoice. Outline: Refund EU-WEST reserved $15,000 (accounting: erroneous reserved charge), credit OVG-TOK $1,500 (migration spike), SLA credit $1,500 (10% monthly). Total credit $18,000. Approver id FIN-APP-8022.
chris: Drafted CM-2026-022 for $18,000. Posting to AR pending approval (attached INC-2026-087, metering CSV, provisioning logs).
nora: Reissued invoice INV-2026-210-R1 created with credit line (-$18,000) new total $13,500. Original marked superseded.
cs-rep: I'll notify SmartGrid with explanation and attach INC/CM/INV-R1. Proposed customer message: "We confirmed an internal provisioning error caused EU-WEST to be billed as a reserved commit. We've issued a credit of $18,000 (reserved refund + burst + contractual SLA credit) and reissued your invoice. Apologies for the disruption; ops has fixed the provisioning race."
finance_lead: Approved CM-2026-022 (FIN-APP-8022). Posting credit in AR completed.
billing-bot: Credit applied, AR transaction TX-AR-99817 created. Logged BILL-2026-390 with attachments.
chris: Good. Closing after customer ACK. Nora, CS will confirm receipt?
nora: Yep will follow up. Closing once SmartGrid confirms. :white_check_mark:
